title: Probe PID 1 that hashes /dev/rmd0 (SHA-256, MMU on, kernel-side read) and prints the digest and elapsed time on the console; builder that pads the donor system.apfs to a 16 KiB multiple and records its SHA-256; decision draft for the first delivery run
acceptance: A static arm64 Mach-O probe built with the project toolchain reads the root device in bounded chunks, computes SHA-256 with an included public-domain or permissively licensed implementation (licence and attribution recorded), prints digest, byte count and seconds; a host build of the same code over a known file gives the digest hashlib gives.

The builder pads 2,475,712,512 B to 2,475,720,704 B (16 KiB multiple) with zeros, records both SHA-256 values and refuses a size that is not a multiple of 4096; Apple data stays under artifacts/, only sizes and hashes are committed.
A decision draft for NAT-078 states the question, the observable (digest equals the image digest, host-to-device rate, rx_bytes), and the pass rule; nothing is run on the phone.
